newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi man beheaded for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi man beheaded for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Saudi man for murder, raising to 75 the number of people executed by the sword in the conservative kingdom this year.
An Interior Ministry statement said the man had shot dead another Saudi man. He was beheaded in the capital Riyadh.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. A total of 68 people were beheaded in 1996.
